summary: Iter 22 cross-cutting validation for Green Lantern (ROUJAUNE couch-to-road). Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass — /api/plan returns 'From Couch to Road' with week_targets {rides:3,duration:'1h 15m',distance_km:24,elevation_m:70,supplementary:3}, progress_pct=0 (empty history) and workouts ctr-ride-1/2/3; /api/calendar/week returns 27 Jul–2 Aug 2026 with Tuesday cycling status 'today', all days carry readiness; /api/rider/season?days=7 returns rides:0/supplementary:0 in the empty zero-state; POST /api/workouts/summarize {workout_id:ctr-ride-1,samples:[]} flips workouts[0].status→completed and adds actual_tss/actual_duration/auto_adjustment on /api/plan and flips Tuesday cycling→completed on /api/calendar/week; POST /api/workouts/summarize with manual RPE body returns manual:true and tss>0 computed from RPE (rpe 3 → intensity 0.60 → tss ~15); POST /api/rider/supplementary/complete increments season.supplementary count. Frontend: Home shows Alberto hero 'From Couch to Road' + 'Welcome Ride · Next up · 20 min · RPE 2–3 · Week 1 · Tue', MetricSummaryStrip has WEEKLY RIDES 0/of 3 planned, TRAINING TIME 0h 0m/1h 15m, DISTANCE 0/24 km, ELEVATION 0/70 m, SUPPLEMENTARY 0/3 planned (actuals correctly zero); Training Plan card shows 'From Couch to Road' with 'View Plan' button that navigates to /plan. Plan screen: Key Workout 'Welcome Ride' tap → /training?workoutId=ctr-ride-1. Calendar 27 Jul–2 Aug 2026 selecting Tuesday and 'View Workout' navigates to /training?workoutId=ctr-ride-1 (NOT /workout). /training?workoutId=ctr-ride-3 shows 'First Endu…' with 'What to Expect' intervals; 'Start Workout' navigates to /workout?workoutId=ctr-ride-3. /workout End Workout → prompt (testID end-ride-prompt) with Save/Abandon/Resume; Abandon returns to '/' and season.rides stays 0 (not recorded); Save navigates to /summary. State was reset after each test.

critical.issue: Module-level state pollution: get_calendar_week (server.py:2026-2035) mutates the shared _CTR_WEEK1 spec dicts in place when applying ctr progress. After a POST /api/workouts/summarize (ctr-ride-*), Tuesday cycling remains status='completed' with the actual duration/TSS overlay even after ride_history is fully cleared, until the backend process is restarted. This means the calendar/plan cannot be 'reset' by deleting ride_history alone. Fix: deep-copy the spec (spec.get('cycling') → copy.deepcopy(spec.get('cycling'))) inside _ctr_calendar_week, so each request returns a fresh dict.

issues: Header still shows a hardcoded date 'Wednesday, 12 May 2025'. Consider showing the couch-to-road day the workout is on (e.g. 'Tuesday, 28 July 2026' for ctr-ride-1).

rca_of_issue: get_calendar_week mutates module-level _CTR_WEEK1 dicts. Repro: (1) mongosh delete ride_history+supplementary_log; (2) curl /api/calendar/week → Tue cycling {status:'today', duration:'20 min', tss:'12 TSS'}; (3) curl -X POST /api/workouts/summarize -d '{"workout_id":"ctr-ride-1","samples":[]}'; (4) mongosh delete ride_history again; (5) curl /api/calendar/week → Tue cycling {status:'completed', duration:'60 min', tss:'92 TSS'} — pollution persists until `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`. Fix: copy.deepcopy on spec dicts inside _ctr_calendar_week, so the overlay in get_calendar_week never mutates the module-level template.
